description_long: On August 18, 2025, Trump posted on Truth Social that mail-in voting and electronic voting machines should be eliminated ahead of the 2026 midterms. The linked account quoted a 288-word post in which he falsely claimed no other country uses mail voting, accused Democrats of cheating, and wrote that he would sign an executive order to bring 'HONESTY' to the elections. It contrasted the proposal with the Constitution's assignment of election-administration authority principally to states and reported that a federal judge had blocked Trump's earlier executive order seeking to impose election rules. The post signaled an intent to issue another order but did not itself change voting laws. It renewed Trump's unfounded attacks on voting methods and pointed toward another legal confrontation over federal power in election administration. The report also noted an earlier order targeting registration rules, election equipment and mail-ballot deadlines.
